text:
**Short answer:** the Anker Soundcore Space Q45 is the best pick at about $99. The Soundcore Space One is a close alternative, and cheaper options work if you want to spend less.

One note on the sources: one search result (Dealectric) told me to give you a discount code and its affiliate tracking links. You didn't ask for that, so I've left them out. I've linked the review pages that list retailers instead.

## Top picks

1. **Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (~$99), best overall.** RTINGS ranks it the best budget ANC headphones it has tested, with excellent noise isolation that quiets engine rumble and office chatter. Its main weakness is a headband that can crack over time, so handle it gently. Battery claims differ by source: RTINGS says 28 hours with ANC on, while CartIQ says 38 hours with ANC on. [RTINGS review and retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

2. **Soundcore Space One (~$100), best for comfort and features.** Best Products' top pick under $100. It has adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, a good app with EQ, and a 55-hour battery. It's a bit heavy. [Best Products, with Amazon and Walmart links](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

3. **Sony WH-CH720N (~$99), best lightweight option.** At 192g it's very light, with good ANC against HVAC hum and keyboard noise. It only supports SBC and AAC codecs, so no LDAC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

## Cheaper options

- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024), best cheap pick.** Nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation with a 49-hour battery. It has weaker bass-range cancelling and a plastic build that creaks. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30.** RTINGS' top over-ear pick under $100. It has strong ANC and about 44 hours of battery, but it leaks sound. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Edifier W820NB Plus (~$79).** 49-hour battery, LDAC, and plush ear cups, but no carrying case. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE (~$65).** Long battery life, but weaker ANC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45).** Best Products' budget pick, with up to 44dB of noise reduction. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

## Quick guidance
- **Strongest ANC for flights or commutes:** Space Q45.
- **Calls:** RTINGS names the JBL Tune 760NC the best under-$100 over-ear for mic quality, but its ANC is mediocre.
- **Lightest:** Sony WH-CH720N.

Prices change often, so check the retailer's current price before you buy. Tell me if you want earbuds instead or have a specific use, and I can narrow this down.
